title: MinecraftDrills
description: Add drills to Minecraft paper server
body:
# What is Minecraft Drills
This plugin implements drills that breaks blocks when pushed with a piston, all drops are silk touched

![View of Drill in a stone generator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/444781619f017759bb63888da94e2cf09ed01ebe.png)
# Crafting a Drill
To craft a drill just place an End Rod next to a Netherite Pickaxe

![Crafting Recipe for Drill](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ea05c24e19bfba18cb7a7aada5beceaed95d0bf.png)
